Fixtures derived from the KoSIT XRechnung test suite and visualization tests (Apache-2.0).
PDF fixtures: zugferd-valid.pdf and public/samples/zugferd.pdf are generated from the KoSIT test suite (Apache-2.0) by spike/zugferd/make-corpus.mjs; zugferd-picture-mismatch.pdf, zugferd-extended.pdf, zugferd1.pdf and plain.pdf are Mustangproject test files (Apache-2.0); zugferd-minimum.pdf is generated.
password.pdf: plain.pdf encrypted with a user password (Ghostscript) to test the unreadable state.
